04 Data Dashboard & Metrik Performa
item.description: Data utama, ringkasan regional, metrik materialized view = hitungan data.

exec: const projects = branches.flatMap(b => b.projects.map(p => ({ ...p, branch: b.name })));
pm.test('Setiap proyek punya 5 jenis kegiatan', () => pm.expect(projects.every(p => p.activities.length === 5)).to.be.true);
pm.test('Setiap ODP punya koordinat & status warna', () => pm.expect(odps.every(o => typeof o.lat === 'number' && typeof o.lon === 'number' && o.occStatus)).to.be.true);

item.name: 05 Query Spasial (PostGIS)
item.description: ODP dalam radius & bounding box; validasi parameter koordinat.

exec: pm.test('ODP di titik pusat ditemukan (jarak 0 m)', () => { pm.expect(body.odps[0].odp).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('sampleOdp')); pm.expect(body.odps[0].distanceM).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('Semua hasil ≤ 1000 m & urut dari terdekat', () => body.odps.forEach((o, i) => { pm.expect(o.distanceM).to.be.at.most(1000); if (i) pm.expect(o.distanceM).to.be.at.least(body.odps[i - 1].distanceM); }));

pm.test('Semua ODP berada di dalam kotak', () => body.odps.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o.lat).to.be.within(v('bboxMinLat'), v('bboxMaxLat')); pm.expect(o.lon).to.be.within(v('bboxMinLon'), v('bboxMaxLon')); }));
pm.test('Tepat 5 hasil & ditandai truncated', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(5); pm.expect(b.truncated).to.be.true; });
